facts: HMLR_S3_UPDATED_20260601
Practice guide 40 supplement 3 was updated on 1 June 2026.
HMLR_S3_GENERAL_BOUNDARIES
The supplement provides an overview of general boundaries.
HMLR_S3_OWNERSHIP_MAINTENANCE
The supplement covers boundary ownership and maintenance.
HMLR_S4_UPDATED_20260601
Practice guide 40 supplement 4 was updated on 1 June 2026.
HMLR_S4_AGREEMENTS_AND_DETERMINED
The supplement explains boundary agreements and determined boundaries.
HMLR_S4_FILED_PLAN_EXACT_LINE
A determined boundary is recorded in affected registers and a filed plan is retained to identify the exact line.
PL_CA_SPECIAL_INTEREST
Conservation areas are areas of special architectural or historic interest whose character or appearance should be preserved or enhanced.
PL_CA_TOTAL_11007
The live dataset reports 11,007 conservation areas.
PL_CA_INCOMPLETE_DUPLICATES
The dataset is a work in progress, is incomplete and contains duplicate conservation areas being reconciled.
PL_LB_LEGAL_PROTECTION
Listed-building data concerns buildings with legal protection for special architectural or historic interest.
PL_LB_POINT_NOT_EXTENT
The dataset supplies a point within a listed building and does not define the affected extent.
PL_LB_TOTAL_382254
The live dataset reports 382,254 listed buildings.
PL_TPZ_GROUP_EXTENT
Tree-preservation-zone data records the extent of groups of trees covered by a tree preservation order.
PL_TPZ_TOTAL_94023
The live dataset reports 94,023 tree-preservation zones.
PL_TPZ_SPEC_DEVELOPMENT
The dataset comes from a limited group of local planning authorities supporting development of a tree-preservation specification.
PL_TPO_PROTECTION_PURPOSE
Tree-preservation-order data supports protection against unauthorised tree removal or damage.
PL_TPO_PUBLIC_AND_DEVELOPER_USE
The data supports public and developer checks and informs planning applications or tree-work proposals.
PL_TPO_TOTAL_107674
The live dataset reports 107,674 tree-preservation orders.
PL_AW_NATURAL_ENGLAND
Ancient woodland areas are designated by Natural England.
PL_AW_PLANNING_GUIDANCE
Natural England and Forestry Commission guidance is used in planning decisions.
PL_AW_TOTAL_44373
The live dataset reports 44,373 ancient woodlands.
PL_AW_STATUS_TWO
The ancient-woodland-status dataset contains two status values.
PL_AW_STATUS_ASNW
ASNW is one published ancient-woodland status reference.
PL_AW_STATUS_PAWS
PAWS is one published ancient-woodland status reference.
PL_CA_SPEC_TWO_DATASETS
The conservation-area specification requires both a conservation-area dataset and a conservation-area-document dataset.
PL_CA_SPEC_FORMATS
Accepted formats include CSV, GeoJSON, GML and GeoPackage.
PL_CA_SPEC_SERVICES
Data may be uploaded at one URL or served through OGC WFS or an ArcGIS API.
EA_PC_XYZ_ATTRIBUTES
The time-stamped point cloud is an archive of high-accuracy x, y and z points with component attributes.
EA_PC_SURFACE_DERIVATION
Environment Agency time-stamped DSM and DTM raster products are derived from point-cloud data.
EA_PC_LAZ_5KM_YEAR
Downloads are grouped in 5 km ZIP files by survey year and contain LAZ files aligned to the OS grid.
EA_NLP_ALL_ENGLAND_1M
The National LIDAR Programme provides 1 metre elevation data for all England.
EA_NLP_302_BLOCKS
England was divided into 302 survey blocks for the phase-one capture programme.
EA_NLP_5KM_PRODUCTS
Programme products are published in 5 km tiles aligned to the Ordnance Survey grid.
EA_GPKG_REPLACES_SHP_INDEX
LiDAR Composite and SurfZone survey ZIP files now use a GeoPackage spatial metadata index rather than a shapefile index.
EA_GPKG_SPATIAL_EXTENT
The GeoPackage index describes the spatial location of raster elevation data.
EA_GPKG_TEMPORAL_EXTENT
The GeoPackage index describes the temporal extent of raster elevation data.
OS_T50_GEMINI
OS Terrain 50 XML metadata follows the GEMINI metadata standard.
OS_T50_INSPIRE_ELEVATION
The metadata records the INSPIRE elevation topic category.
OS_T50_PER_TILE_METADATA
OS Terrain 50 provides metadata on a per-tile basis, including the 10 km National Grid tile reference.
OS_T50_NO_REGISTRATION
OS Terrain 50 is supplied as an online download with no registration required.
OS_T50_2858_TILES
The national dataset contains 2,858 ten-kilometre tiles.
OS_T50_55_FOLDERS
The national tiles are arranged into 55 folders representing 100 km grid squares.
OS_T50_NO_LIVE_ISSUES
The known-data-issues page reports no live OS Terrain 50 issues at the time of access.
OS_T50_RESOLVED_RETENTION
Resolved issue details remain listed until the next product release.
OS_T50_REPORT_CONTACT
Unlisted issues can be reported through the Ordnance Survey contact route.
OS_T50_XML_SCHEMA
The OS Terrain XML schema resources include contour and gridded product schemas.
OS_T50_STYLE_METADATA
The downloads page also identifies viewing-style metadata resources.
OS_T50_SCHEMA_LICENCE
Use of the XML schemas is governed by the XML File Repository Licence.
